title: NAKED 100 E-Liquid 50ml Shotfill – Polar Breeze
description:
Polar Breeze by Naked 100 is made with Fruits and cool ice. On each inhale you can taste Pineapple flavour with its rich sweet and juicy flavour followed with honeydew and cantaloupe melon just at the tip of your tongue and on exhale the cool Ice cuts through the sweetness and making Polar Breeze a flavour that can be enjoyed throughout the day!
Naked 100 Polar Breeze comes in 60ml bottle with 10ml space to add one nicotine shot for 3mg strength.
Naked 100 are manufactured in US California and they carry menthol fruit, tobacco and cream flavour with high VG concentration for premium quality eliquid.
Nicotine Level:
Zero – 0mg
VG/PG:
70% VG 30% PG
Bottle Size:
60ml filled with 50ml to add your nicotine shot
